channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Netflix Titus Adds Single-Tenant VM Isolation for Containers
item.description: Netflix has added single-tenant Titus, a mode that runs one task alone on its own right-sized EC2 instance. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Microsoft Retires Azure Deployment Environments with No Replacement Product
item.description: Azure Deployment Environments retires on February 22, 2027 and Microsoft names no successor, telling teams to use Bicep or ARM templates directly. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle and SQL Server now support storage autoscaling on additional storage volumes
item.description: Amazon RDS for SQL Server and Amazon RDS for Oracle now support RDS storage autoscaling on additional storage volumes . (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Aurora now supports post-quantum TLS key exchange
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition introduces support for post-quantum TLS (PQ-TLS) key exchange, providing you with post-quantum cryptography options for encrypting your data in transit. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) is now available in additional Regions
item.description: Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) is now available in two additional AWS Regions: Canada (Central) and Africa (Cape Town). (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Marketplace now enables partners to list once and sell through multiple subsidiary accounts
item.description: Today, AWS announces that AWS partners who operate multiple legal entities can publish a product listing once in their primary account and enable their local subsidiaries to sell it through direct private offers — eliminating the need to… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon MSK Connect now supports updating connector plugins and worker configurations
item.description: Amazon MSK Connect (Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka Connect) now lets you update the custom plugin and worker configuration of an existing connector. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Step Functions workflows now available as AI agent tools
item.description: You can now use your AWS Step Functions workflows as tools for AI agents through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway. (1 source: aws)
